rule: Exactly these 21 status labels. No synonyms. Every status must also be distinguishable without colour (icon plus text) for accessibility.

statuses.label: Draft
statuses.meaning: Editable, no control effect.

statuses.label: Submitted
statuses.meaning: Awaiting first approval decision.

statuses.label: Under Review
statuses.meaning: Approver has opened it.

statuses.label: Approved
statuses.meaning: Approved; downstream action permitted.

statuses.label: Rejected
statuses.meaning: Terminal for this version; a new version may be raised.

statuses.label: Returned
statuses.meaning: Sent back to requestor for correction.

statuses.label: Released
statuses.meaning: Budget released; procurement permitted.

statuses.label: Partially Committed
statuses.meaning: Some but not all budget consumed by open POs.

statuses.label: Fully Committed
statuses.meaning: Open PO commitment equals available budget.

statuses.label: Partially Actualised
statuses.meaning: Some committed value converted to actual CWIP.

statuses.label: Fully Actualised
statuses.meaning: All committed value converted to actual CWIP.

statuses.label: Budget Exceeded
statuses.meaning: Exposure exceeds current approved budget.

statuses.label: Exception Pending
statuses.meaning: Over-budget transaction awaiting exception approval.

statuses.label: Technically Completed
statuses.meaning: Physical work complete; financial postings may continue.

statuses.label: Financially Completed
statuses.meaning: No further postings permitted.

statuses.label: Awaiting Capitalisation
statuses.meaning: CWIP eligible for transfer to fixed assets.

statuses.label: Capitalised
statuses.meaning: CWIP transferred to fixed asset(s).

statuses.label: Closed
statuses.meaning: Terminal. Procurement and posting blocked.

statuses.label: Reopened
statuses.meaning: Reopened under controlled approval; audit trail records who and why.

statuses.label: Integration Failed
statuses.meaning: Outbound or inbound sync failed; retry or dead-letter.

statuses.label: Reconciliation Pending
statuses.meaning: Source and target values differ beyond tolerance.
